profiles.shortDescription: KOCH-TECHNIK develops and manufactures auxiliary equipment and material-handling systems for plastics processing. Its range covers dosing, mixing, conveying and drying of plastic granulate.
fullDescription: Werner Koch Maschinentechnik's official site identifies KOCH-TECHNIK as a manufacturer of machines and systems for plastics processing.
The documented portfolio includes dosing and mixing equipment, material conveyors, granulate dryers and central material-supply systems for injection-moulding and extrusion operations.

profiles.officialName: Koellmann Gear, a division of Thielenhaus Technologies GmbH
profiles.shortDescription: Koellmann Gear is a division of Thielenhaus Technologies that develops industrial and application-specific gear units. Its portfolio includes extruder, injection-moulding, test-bench, saw, shredder, mixer and special gearboxes.
fullDescription: Koellmann Gear's official site identifies the business as a division of Thielenhaus Technologies GmbH with roots dating to 1904.

The published range spans extruder and injection-moulding gearboxes, H-TEC industrial gear units, test-bench, saw, shredder, straightening, mixer and oil-press gearboxes, plus engineered special units.

profiles.shortDescription: Kolmeks manufactures centrifugal pumps and electric motors for building services, water systems and industrial processes. Its pump range includes in-line, circulation, booster and process configurations with fixed-speed or integrated variable-speed drives.
fullDescription: Kolmeks' official product site documents pump and motor manufacturing for HVAC, water circulation and industrial duties.

The range includes in-line centrifugal pumps, domestic-water and booster pumps, pool and process pumps, integrated frequency-converter models and electric motors, supported by technical documentation and selection tools.

profiles.shortDescription: KONČAR develops and manufactures electrical, energy and transport technologies. Its industrial portfolio covers power generation, transmission and distribution equipment, rotating machines, digital systems and rail vehicles.
fullDescription: KONČAR's official corporate site presents a Croatian engineering and manufacturing group established in 1921.
Its published solutions span power plants and renewable generation, transformers and substations, electric motors and generators, digital control and monitoring systems, and electric rail vehicles.

profiles.shortDescription: Kongsberg Automotive develops components and systems for commercial and passenger vehicles. Its portfolio includes driver-control, fluid-transfer, couplings, actuator, powertrain and seat-comfort technologies.
fullDescription: Kongsberg Automotive's official site identifies a vehicle-technology supplier with manufacturing and engineering operations serving mobility markets.
The documented product portfolio includes off-highway and commercial-vehicle controls, fluid-transfer assemblies, drivetrain couplings, shift and actuator systems, and seat-comfort products.

profiles.shortDescription: KÖNIG METALL manufactures customer-specific sheet-metal and tube components and assemblies. Its capabilities cover forming, welding, laser processing, tube processing, surface treatment and special tooling.
fullDescription: KÖNIG METALL's official site describes a family-owned group that processes sheet metal and tubes for industrial customers.
The documented capabilities include stamping, drawing and bending, welded assemblies, tube processing, laser cutting and welding, surface treatment, toolmaking and special-machine construction.

profiles.shortDescription: Körting Hannover develops ejectors, vacuum systems and process equipment based on jet-pump technology. Its range also includes gas-cleaning, steam-jet refrigeration and liquid-jet mixing systems.
fullDescription: Körting Hannover's official site documents a German process-equipment manufacturer with roots dating to 1871.
Its portfolio includes steam, gas and liquid ejectors, vacuum plants, steam-jet refrigeration systems, gas-scrubbing equipment, jet mixers and engineered systems for process industries.

profiles.shortDescription: Koyo is a JTEKT bearing brand for industrial and mobility applications. The official portfolio covers ball, roller, needle and special-purpose bearings together with engineering support and related components.
fullDescription: JTEKT's official Koyo site identifies Koyo as a bearing brand within the JTEKT group.
The published range includes deep-groove, angular-contact and thrust ball bearings, cylindrical, tapered and spherical roller bearings, needle bearings, housed units and engineered bearing solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Kraus & Naimer manufactures switching devices for industrial control and electrical isolation. Its core range includes cam switches, switch-disconnectors, control switches and customized switching solutions.
fullDescription: Kraus & Naimer's official site documents an Austrian manufacturer of electrical switching technology founded in 1907.
The product portfolio includes cam-operated switches, main and maintenance switches, switch-disconnectors, control switches, enclosures and application-specific switching assemblies.

fullDescription: KraussMaffei's official site presents a machinery manufacturer serving plastics and rubber processing.

profiles.shortDescription: Krautzberger manufactures spray and coating equipment for industrial surface applications. Its range includes automatic and manual spray guns, material supply, pressure vessels, pumps and complete coating systems.
fullDescription: Krautzberger's official site documents a German manufacturer of surface-coating technology founded in 1902.

profiles.shortDescription: KROHNE develops process measurement instruments and engineered metering systems. Its portfolio covers flow, level, temperature, pressure and analytical measurement together with communication and monitoring solutions.
fullDescription: KROHNE's official site identifies a process-instrumentation manufacturer founded in 1921.

fullDescription: Kroll Energy's official site identifies the company as a manufacturer specialising in industrial heating, cooling and dehumidification equipment for more than six decades.

profiles.shortDescription: KTR develops and manufactures drive components and systems for mechanical and plant engineering. Its portfolio includes shaft couplings, torque limiters, clamping sets, brakes, hydraulic components and cooling systems.
fullDescription: KTR's official site documents a German drive-technology manufacturer founded in 1959.

The published range covers flexible, rigid and backlash-free couplings, torque limiters, clamping technology, industrial brakes, hydraulic components, oil-air coolers and condition-monitoring solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Ledinek manufactures machinery and complete lines for solid-wood and engineered-timber processing. Its systems cover planing, profiling, finger-jointing, gluing, pressing and automated handling.

profiles.shortDescription: The Lee Company manufactures miniature precision fluid-control components. Its range includes valves, pumps, restrictors, nozzles, filters and fluidic manifolds for demanding compact systems.
